title: P2N: Reusing Deep Representations for Greater Effective Depth
abstract: arXiv:2610.25076v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mathematical problem solving and autonomous agents are increasingly important applications of language models, demanding stronger reasoning capabilities. Computational depth is a key resource for such reasoning, but adding model layers increases both training and inference costs, while test-time scaling incurs substantial additional inference computation. We introduce P2N (Previous to Next), which reuses the previous token's deep representations, already available during generation, to increase effective computational depth with negligible decoding overhead. Specifically, P2N adds the previous token's deep hidden state to the current token's shallow representation, allowing subsequent layers to build on previously completed deep computation. This recurrence extends effective computational depth across tokens, while introducing only a single vector addition per decoding step. We train the recurrence using parallel Jacobi updates restr

translated_title: P2N：重用深层表示以获得更大的有效计算深度
translated_abstract: 数学问题求解和自主智能体是语言模型日益重要的应用，它们需要更强的推理能力。计算深度是这类推理的关键资源，但增加模型层数会同时增加训练和推理成本，而测试时扩展（test-time scaling）则会带来大量额外的推理计算。我们提出了P2N（Previous to Next），该方法重用前一个token在生成过程中已经可用的深层表示，以几乎可忽略的解码开销来增加有效计算深度。具体而言，P2N将前一个token的深层隐藏状态添加到当前token的浅层表示中，使后续层能够建立在之前已完成的深度计算之上。这种递归方式将有效计算深度扩展到跨token范围，同时每个解码步骤仅引入一次向量加法。我们使用并行Jacobi更新来训练这种递归机制……
tldr: P2N通过将前一个token的深层隐藏状态加到当前token的浅层表示上，以每步仅一次向量加法的极小开销，将模型的有效计算深度跨token递归扩展，从而在不增加层数的前提下显著提升语言模型的推理能力。
en_tdlr: P2N reuses the previous token's deep hidden state by adding it to the current token's shallow representation, recursively extending the model's effective computational depth across tokens with only a single vector addition per decoding step, thereby boosting reasoning without adding layers.
